name.description: The name of the workspace, in the format 'projects/{projectId}/locations/{location}/datasets/{datasetId}/dataMapperWorkspaces/{workspaceId}'
name.rationale: The name is a resource identifier only and does not affect security posture.

settings.description: Settings associated with this workspace. Structure is [documented below](#nested_settings).
settings.rationale: The settings block is a required container for workspace configuration and does not directly affect security posture.

data_project_ids.description: Project IDs for data projects hosted in a workspace.
data_project_ids.rationale: The data_project_ids field defines which projects are associated with the workspace. Access control for those projects is governed by their own IAM policies, not this field directly.

dataset.description: Identifies the dataset addressed by this request. Must be in the format 'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/datasets/{dataset}'
dataset.rationale: The dataset field is a required reference to the parent dataset and does not directly affect security posture.

labels.description: The user labels. An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" } **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are essential for resource governance, cost attribution, and access control enforcement. Missing or unapproved labels make it impossible to identify workspace ownership, classify PHI mapping workloads, and apply organisation-wide security policies consistently.
labels.non-compliant: labels not set (null) or missing required keys environment and owner
